learning.why: teacher ne ungliyon par ginwake dikhaya ki 6 aur 4 bhi 10 bana sakte hain
teacher asked for 7 plus something to 10, child counted fingers and discovered 7+3, realising order doesn't matter right now
The teacher made me count 6 and 4 on my fingers and I saw it really works, not just 5 and 5; now I know many pairs exist and I can find 7 and 3.
When she asked 7 and how many more, I realised it's the same as 3 and 7 which she showed earlier.

end.summary: Practised finding number partners that make 10.
end.parentNote: Gauri used finger counting to find 6+4, 7+3, and 8+2. They first said only 5+5 makes 10, then corrected this after counting and gave more pairs. At home, ask Gauri to find three different pairs that make 10 using fingers or small objects.
